title: Ashmita Chaliha Wins Maiden BWF World Tour Title at Korea Masters
indian_angle: Ashmita Chaliha's victory marks a significant milestone for Indian badminton, being only the fifth Indian woman to win a Super 300 or higher title.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha secured her first BWF World Tour title at the Korea Masters, making a strong comeback after a career-threatening knee injury in 2024.

title: PV Sindhu Reacts to Langur Mimics for Monkey Deterrence at Worlds
